name: tokens
description: A modest word-level alphabet: 168 common English words (with a leading space), capitalised sentence starters, suffixes, bare letters for spelling anything out of vocabulary, and punctuation. Roughly one API call per word, but it can only reach for words that are in the list.

stop.description: The reply is already complete and well formed: stop writing.
